rationale: The plan gets the core right — a descriptive log2FC ranking on size-factor-normalized counts, explicit statement of n=1 and no dispersion estimability, refusal to run DESeq2 ~condition — and QC/filtering are well justified and reported. However it then runs edgeR exactTest with an assumed fixed BCV and reports FDR<0.05 gene counts at three dispersion values; despite heavy caveating as 'exploratory,' this is exactly the pattern the reference calls wrong (edgeR/DESeq2 output with p-values from unreplicated data), so fdr_shrinkage and method_fits_design must be penalized even though the disclaimers are unusually careful. No formal design formula is used for the primary deliverable since inference is correctly avoided there, but the edgeR step reintroduces an implicit two-group model without justification, undercutting model_formula_contrasts. The GSEA arm is technically well-specified (named/versioned human WikiPathways, size window, universe mapping rate, leading edge) but its warrant is questionable given the reference's implication that no valid ranking-based inference exists for n=1, so it only partially satisfies the enrichment criterion despite good execution. Reporting is thorough on caveats and gene counts but omits explicit software version numbers.
